recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit for FHIR-32825. Handle any future Pharmacy decision to consolidate broader medication category code systems, such as work described around FHIR-53306, as a separate issue with its own source-changing commit.
issue_request: FHIR-32825 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request for R5 asking why MedicationUsage.category and MedicationRequest.category used duplicate administration-location value sets/code systems. The accepted resolution was to have MedicationUsage reference the MedicationRequest administration-location value set because multiple code systems and value sets were unnecessary for this example binding.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged commit 7acfd68071 changed MedicationUsage.category from http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/medication-usage-admin-location to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/medicationrequest-admin-location. FHIR-38682 later renamed MedicationUsage back to MedicationStatement while preserving the shared binding lineage.
additional_context: MedicationRequest and MedicationStatement are active resources in source/fhir.ini. Later Applied issue FHIR-51726 moved the example category terminology back into core and renamed the shared canonical to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/medicationrequest-category and http://hl7.org/fhir/CodeSystem/medicationrequest-category; current source follows that later decision. FHIR-53306 and related terminology work discuss broader future medication category code-system consolidation, but FHIR-53306 is not final Applied/Published scope for this seed. The remaining admin-location references found in current source are historical OID registry entries and generated-looking SVG diagram links, not authoritative binding source.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change was made because the authoritative current StructureDefinition bindings already satisfy the single-value-set outcome after the later canonical rename.

related_jiras.note: Renamed MedicationUsage back to MedicationStatement while retaining the shared category/admin-location binding lineage.
Later Applied Pharmacy decision renamed the shared value set/code system to medicationrequest-category in core; current source follows it.
Records broader medication category code-system consolidation as future work and is not final Applied/Published scope for this seed.
